name: Tata Consultancy Services Limited
remarksWeb: The Company is a subsidiary of Tata Sons Private Limited (TSPL) which holds 72.02% in the Company as on September 30, 2019. TSPL is a Core Investment Company and as an investment vehicle, it  is exempted from the Companies (Significant Beneficial Owners ) Rules,2018 (SBO Rules)  on the investment made by it. The Company does not have any other Significant Beneficial Owner as per the SBO Rules. n
